theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Y : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : NNReal) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (w : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → MeasurableSet Y → IsCompact (closure Y) → closure Y ⊆ V → LipschitzWith K h → (∀ y ∈ Y, h (ψ y) = F y) → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (hs k)) → (∀ k x, ‖fderiv ℝ (hs k) x‖ ≤ K) → TendstoUniformly hs h atTop → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict (ψ '' Y)), ∀ y ∈ Y, ψ y = x → ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (G x) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → IntegrableOn w (ψ '' Y) μHE[n + 1] → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict (ψ '' Y)), ∀ y ∈ Y, ψ y = x → w x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in ψ '' Y, fderiv ℝ (hs k) x (w x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in ψ '' Y, inner ℝ (G x) (w x) ∂μHE[n + 1]))
